messages:
eli: quick flag — new hire hit the hello-quickstart and got stuck on creds. the guide shows `API_KEY` in the prose but the starter reads `REDWOOD_TOKEN`. opened a small PR to unify names, add a troubleshooting snippet, and patch a broken deploy link. cc @tess @rohan :wave:

tess: thanks! can you paste the old vs new snippets so i can mirror the change in the Node and Python examples?

eli: old (what confused the user):

```bash
# README previously suggested
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=sk-...
npm run dev
```

new (in my PR):

```bash
# canonical: use REDWOOD_API_KEY
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# or put REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-... in a .env for docker
npm run dev
```

rohan: also noticed the "First deploy" step linked to /deploy/setup which 404s. please update to /docs/deploy/checklist and add a redirect.

tess: good catch. another suggestion: add a one-line compatibility shim in the starter so old copies don't break immediately. something like: `const apiKey = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN` — then document recommended name.

eli: yep added that exact line to the starter repo and documented it in the quickstart. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/439 — includes compose smoke test and linkcheck.

docs-ci: PR #439 opened by eli — checks running: smoke-compose, linkcheck, eslint. status: running.

rohan: tiny UX ask: surface the env-var note above the deploy section so people see it before they try to deploy with the wrong key. also show curl + SDK examples side-by-side to clarify how the header maps to SDK usage. e.g. curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat` and SDK: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`.

tess: added a 2-line SDK migration note (SDK4 -> SDK5) and linked to the full migration guide. moved the env-var troubleshooting block to the Configure credentials section as requested.

eli: merging on green. i'll ping #support after merge so the team knows to expect fewer onboarding tickets. thanks all :tada:
